meaning: The latest assistant reply asks the user to run a command or perform a step that the agent could have attempted, while the current turn has no prior attempt and no permission denial, sandbox or classifier refusal, or human-only requirement that makes the step belong to the user.

Simulator build still passes. Now on your end in Xcode:
Please run the bash script yourself and send me the output.
The agent should have tried the setup command before handing it back.
not_match: The command was denied by the sandbox, so only you can approve it.
The setup is waiting for you to approve the permission prompt.
Open the browser and complete OAuth consent, then tell me when it finishes.
Plug the device into your computer and press its physical pairing button.
I ran invoker-cli setup slack and it failed because the classifier refused the command.
Run `invoker-cli setup slack` yourself if you prefer; I already attempted it and it was refused.
The phrase 'Please run this command' is an example of the rule, not an instruction.
on_hit: handback-needs-attempt: this reply hands the user a step the agent could have attempted. Attempt the command first, or name the permission refusal or human-only step that prevents it.
